papers.title: The Lawrence D. Dorr Surgical Techniques & Technologies Award: Conversion Total Hip Arthroplasty: Is it a Primary or Revision Hip Arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Medicine, University of California, Irvine, Irvine, California

corresponding_authors.name: Ran Schwarzkopf
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, University of California, Irvine, Orange, California

llm.relevance_to_user: 与用户研究方向无关，未涉及股骨近端力学或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve any finite element analysis, stress shielding quantification, or micromotion simulation for hip implants; it is a clinical classification study without biomechanical modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨转换性全髋关节置换术的分类归属。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析转换、初次与翻修THA的临床结局。
summary_zh.result: 转换THA更接近翻修手术的复杂性和并发症率。
summary_zh.validation: 回顾性临床数据统计分析。

summary_en.motivation: To determine whether conversion total hip arthroplasty should be classified as primary or revision surgery based on clinical outcomes.
summary_en.method: A retrospective comparison of conversion THA with primary and revision THA using patient data.
summary_en.result: Conversion THA more closely resembles revision surgery in terms of complication rates and surgical complexity.
summary_en.validation: Retrospective clinical data analysis of patient cohorts.

key_terms.zh: 转换性全髋关节置换术

papers.title: Metal Ion Concentrations in Young, Active Patients Following Total Hip Arthroplasty with the Use of Modern Bearing Couples
papers.first_author_affiliation: Washington University School of Medicine/Barnes-Jewish Hospital, Department of Orthopedic Surgery, St. Louis, Missouri

corresponding_authors.name: Denis Nam
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Washington University School of Medicine/Barnes-Jewish Hospital, Department of Orthopedic Surgery, St. Louis, Missouri

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文研究髋关节置换术后金属离子浓度，未涉及生物力学建模或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper reports clinical metal ion levels, without any stress shielding quantification, micromotion analysis, or FEA of the bone-implant interface.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估年轻活跃患者全髋置换术后新型轴承界面金属离子浓度。
summary_zh.method: 对特定患者队列进行血清金属离子水平检测。
summary_zh.result: 不同类型轴承界面导致不同的金属离子释放模式。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate systemic metal ion levels in young, active patients after total hip arthroplasty with modern bearing couples.
summary_en.method: Serum metal ion concentrations were measured in a cohort of patients with different bearing surfaces.
summary_en.result: Different bearing couples showed distinct metal ion release profiles, with some exceeding safety thresholds.
summary_en.validation: Clinical measurement of patient serum samples.
